claim: Gotchas (2026-05-26): Tone.Oscillator + setValueAtTime pushed at UI rate (~60 Hz) 'is enough to feel Kuramoto locking on two audio-rate sines' — no per-sample worklet needed, because Web Audio renders the automation at audio rate.

pieces.what: The claim under Tone, tested with plain Web Audio (Tone cannot load here): two OscillatorNodes coupled by frequency automation pushed at 60 Hz against an AudioWorklet integrating the same Kuramoto equation per sample; the lock measured in rendered output (OfflineAudioContext): beat rate, instantaneous frequency difference and phase spread as K crosses K_c = |Δf|/2, both arms. Does 'feel' survive as a number?

The explorer's HUD rebuilt without Tone: drift / pulling in / lock as K crosses K_c, with the beating audible on a click; the shipped Tone explorer gathered beside it for the reader whose browser can load the CDN.
